deal.title: Sunstate Medical Transport — AI Automation Pilot
deal.label: Hot

activities.subject: Initial discovery call
activities.note: Tony described their current manual call-ahead process. Dispatchers spend 2-3 hours daily calling facilities. They've looked at Halo Health but found their pricing too high and integration timeline too long (6 months). Tony is very interested in a faster, more affordable solution. They handle about 120 transports per day across 8 facilities in the Phoenix metro area.

activities.subject: Demo walkthrough
activities.note: Walked through Retell AI call-ahead demo. Tony approved pilot for 3 facilities (Phoenix, Scottsdale, Mesa). Committed to March 15 start date. Budget approved at $3,500/month. Tony flagged HIPAA compliance as critical requirement — needs BAA before go-live. Also mentioned need for Spanish language support (30% of facility contacts). Tony's operations director Sarah is on board. Competitor Halo Health was mentioned again — Tony said our pricing and timeline are much better.

activities.subject: Pricing follow-up
activities.note: Sent formal pricing breakdown. Tony confirmed budget is approved but needs formal pricing document by March 7 for procurement process. Wants BAA and data flow documentation included in SOW package.
